Containment uses a sole non-inheritable job handle with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE and no breakaway flags. CreateProcessW must use STARTUPINFOEXW, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST 0x0002000D, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST 0x00020002, CREATE_SUSPENDED, EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, explicit lpApplicationName, and only intended stdout/stderr inherited handles. Never create then AssignProcessToJobObject. Any pre-resume failure terminates the job and proves it empty.

Inventory and cleanup use Toolhelp only as a basename prefilter, then retained process handles with canonical image and creation FILETIME. Access denial or unverifiable live same-basename process is CleanupFailure and blocks launch. Do not kill from PID, parent PID, fixture data, or an unverified reopened handle. Process32First failure and Process32Next errors other than ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES fail closed. ParentProcessId is informational only.

Command lines come from the retained process handle with validated UNICODE_STRING bounds and CommandLineToArgvW parsing. Inspect options before standalone --. Exact --headless is required; --headless=* is ambiguous. A headless same-image process must contain exactly one nonempty absolute project path across --path VALUE or --path=VALUE. Missing, duplicate, relative, inaccessible, or malformed values are CleanupFailure. Compare opened directory file identity, not path spelling.

Native runtime assertions are mandatory before native use. PROCESSENTRY32W sizes are x86 556/x64 568 with pointer-correct offsets; JOBOBJECT_BASIC_LIMIT_INFORMATION ActiveProcessLimit is DWORD and total sizes are x86 48/x64 64; IO_COUNTERS is 48; JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION is x86 112/x64 144; UNICODE_STRING is 8/16; STARTUPINFOW 68/104; STARTUPINFOEXW 72/112; PROCESS_INFORMATION 16/24. Focused helpers must exercise System32 x64 and SysWOW64 x86 PowerShell where available and fail explicitly when a required configured helper is unavailable.

TimeoutSeconds is one budget from the supervisor first statement through startup, compile, canonicalization, mutex, inventory, cleanup, launch, execution, capture, fatal scan, and cleanup. Reserve R=min(2000ms,max(250ms,ceil(T/10))) for worker teardown; supervisor wall bound is T plus at most 1000 ms. Deadline during preexisting CLEANUP_BEGIN is CleanupFailure; engine deadline with proven containment cleanup is Timeout.

Protocol stdout is only newline-delimited authenticated GTR1 READY/PHASE/FINAL frames: version, nonce, bounded base64url JSON, SHA-256, max 16 KiB. Reject partial, duplicate, extra, wrong-nonce, inconsistent-category, or bad-hash frames. Engine output never shares the protocol pipe. Supervisor constructs the authoritative result with exactly status, category, processExitCode, elapsedSeconds, project, logPath, cleanedPids.

Exit precedence is CleanupFailure/7, Timeout/2, LockContention/4, InvalidInput/6, PreexistingHeadlessProcess/5, LaunchFailure/8, FatalOutput/3, ProcessFailure/1, Success/0. Success requires zero root exit, empty job, complete output, no fatal marker, and verified cleanup.
